title: OpenAI expands its AWS cloud deal by $100B over 8 years

sources.quote: OpenAI and AWS are expanding their existing $38 billion multi-year agreement by $100 billion over 8 years.

In Q1 2026, AWS and OpenAI Group PBC (“OpenAI”) announced an expansion of the existing $38.0 billion multi-year commitment and commercial arrangement with OpenAI by $100.0 billion over 8.0 years, which includes contractual obligations related to the performance of AWS chips.

explain: On top of its earlier $38 billion AWS contract, OpenAI agreed to spend another $100 billion on Amazon's cloud over eight years, including about 2 gigawatts of Amazon's own Trainium AI chips. It came alongside Amazon's plan to invest $50 billion in OpenAI, so money flows both ways.
